snippet.title: Mars Incremental – Announcement Trailer | A Short Incremental Game About Fixing a Planet
snippet.description:
Mars Incremental is Pixel Hound's upcoming short incremental game about terraforming Mars—one idle tick at a time. This is the official announcement trailer.
🚀 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4179880/Mars_IDLE/

🎮 Play the demo on itch.io: https://pixelhound.itch.io/mars-idle
Mars is cold, dead, and frankly a bit of a fixer-upper. Your job is to change that. Build, automate, and watch the numbers go up as a barren rock slowly becomes something almost livable. It's a cozy, self-running incremental game you can dip into whenever—no rush, the planet isn't going anywhere.
Coming to Steam, with a demo available now. Wishlisting genuinely helps a tiny studio like ours get noticed, so if Mars Incremental looks like your kind of thing, that little button means a lot.
Follow Pixel Hound:

🌐 itch.io: https://pixelhound.itch.io

#IdleGame #IncrementalGame #IndieGame #SBGames2026
